fields.summary_ko.0: Despite Anthropic (ANT) IPO, the Nasdaq has lost all gains since the start of the year, with Nvidia (NVDA) falling 42% over four weeks and Micron (MU) falling 33% over one month, as the AI trading selloff continues.
fields.summary_ko.1: Some strategists have evaluated recent AI-related stocks as being in a 'fire sale' state, with computer trading fund involvement expected to be a key monitoring focus next week.
